title: Template:T/doc
content: ;Description :A template link with a variable number of example parameters (0-20), which can be used to show example inputs. :Utilises [[Template:T/piece]]. ;Syntax :{{t|t|parameter1|parameter2|parameter3|parameter4|...|parameter20}} ;Sample code :{{t|welcome}} gives... :{{t|welcome}} :{{t|welcome|Item1|Item2|Item3|Item4|Item5|...}} gives... :{{t|welcome|Item1|Item2|Item3|Item4|Item5|...}} ;See also :[[w:c:wow:Template:T|Template:T]] on WoWWiki [[Category:General wiki templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
